chip.description: Tilemap generator: two ROM-sourced 8x8 background layers with rowscroll (one also with columnscroll) plus a RAM-sourced foreground text layer, mixed on-die into a 15-bit pixel stream, and emitting HSYNC/HBLANK/VSYNC/VBLANK (taxonomy §4.18 example).
chip.notes: src/mame/taito/tc0100scn.cpp in MAME 0.288, whose pin list is taken from the Operation Thunderbolt schematics.
